enabled.description: Enable Claude's extended thinking capability for complex reasoning.
enabled.label: Extended Thinking

k.description: Limit token selection to top K candidates.
k.label: Top K

concurrentLimit.description: Maximum simultaneous requests for this provider. Leave empty to use only the global execution limit.
concurrentLimit.label: Provider Concurrency

maxRetries.description: Number of retry attempts on failure.
maxRetries.label: Max Retries

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a response (ms).
timeout.label: Request Timeout

enableReasoning.description: Enable deep thinking for complex tasks.
enableReasoning.label: Enable Reasoning

frequencyPenalty.description: Reduces repetition by penalizing frequently used tokens.
frequencyPenalty.label: Frequency Penalty

groundingEnabled.description: Enable Google Search grounding for responses.
groundingEnabled.label: Grounding / Web Search

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens in the response.
maxTokens.label: Max Tokens

safePrompt.description: Inject a safety prompt before the conversation.
safePrompt.label: Safe Prompt

keepAlive.description: How long to keep the model loaded (e.g., '5m', '1h').
keepAlive.label: Keep Alive

mirostat.description: Mirostat sampling mode for perplexity control.
mirostat.label: Mirostat Sampling

numGpu.description: Number of layers to offload to GPU.
numGpu.label: GPU Layers

logprobs.description: Include token log probabilities in the response.
logprobs.label: Log Probabilities

reasoningEffort.description: How much effort the model puts into reasoning (o-series models only).
reasoningEffort.label: Reasoning Effort

responseFormat.description: Force the model to output in a specific format.
responseFormat.label: Response Format

presencePenalty.description: Encourages new topics by penalizing tokens that already appeared.
presencePenalty.label: Presence Penalty

resetConfirm: Reset all parameters to their default values?

temperature.description: Controls randomness. Lower = more focused, higher = more creative.
temperature.label: Temperature

topK.description: Limit token selection to top K candidates.
topK.label: Top K

topP.description: Nucleus sampling. Consider tokens with top_p probability mass.
topP.label: Top P

searchEnabled.description: Allow Grok to search the web.
searchEnabled.label: Web Search
